implementation_notes: Include the upstream's published header directly and use its types as your own; do not wrap or redefine them. Keep the include in one header so the conformity surface is visible and replaceable.
idiom_name: #include the upstream header directly, no wrapper
code_sketch:
/* billing/customer_conformist.h — the ONLY place that knows conformity */
#include "identity/customer.h"   /* upstream types used verbatim */
pitfalls: Re-declaring upstream structs in your own header — that is a half-finished translation layer
Upstream changing its struct layout without changing its version
